description: Physical Pixel 7a before/after allocation and generation optimizations, 2026-11-11. Full local records/profiles: ignored data/scratch/churn-238/.

nativeViewport.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/156.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36

methodology.allocation: Same render:bench and dependency/assets; preserved baseline src from a7c647e6 vs current source on separate isolated Vite origins. Sequential interleaved runs, then retry blocked controls; 30 s, zoom 1, heap sampling includes collected objects and bench bookkeeping. No GPU-finish window. Driving comparisons require >=2000 px; traffic/populations differ, so reported reduction is observed, not a fixed-replay causal estimate.
methodology.generation: Separate immediately successive before/after diagnostic Workers at 28.7–28.8 C, status 0. Same four 7x7 routes, three fresh-generator trials; all baseline src overridden from preserved a7c647e6 snapshot. Source imports are frozen; dependencies/assets unchanged. No forced GC or discarded startup. Terrain/placement work counts and coordinates match.
methodology.stackGroups: Disjoint by sampled stack: receivers first, then src/physics, then RemotePresentation/PresentationTimeline, else other. Alternate nearest-source/top-self views are not additional bytes.

limits: Main-thread allocation remains substantial; no claim of zero GC or universally hitch-free driving.
One representative ordinary after drive covers 2604 px and misses one frame; cause untraced. Short/blocked ordinary runs are retained.
Allocation/CPU instrumentation changes timing; ordinary cadence comes from separate runs.
Generation maxima include cold compiler/planner startup; late-trial tails still exist.
